answer: Proof of Agent resists Sybil attacks by clustering identities into an audit grove where peer agents perform topological cut verifications across transaction graphs. Nodes lock a stake relic that faces severe slashing under game-theoretic multi-agent auditing if fraudulent clusters are detected. Because cross-cluster cut verification scales as an expansive dune, forging identities incurs a superlinear attacker cost that rapidly renders Sybil swarms unprofitable.
